summary.text: John Lombardi is a Democratic state representative who has represented Rhode Island House of Representatives District 8 since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is an attorney and teacher by background.

paragraphs.text: Lombardi earned a B.A. in social studies from Rhode Island College in 1975, an M.Ed. in secondary education from Rhode Island College in 1982, and a J.D. from Suffolk University College of Law in 1987.

His professional experience includes work as an attorney, as legal counsel to the Rhode Island Senate Labor and Corporations committees from 1989 to 1992, as a substitute teacher for the Providence School Department from 1975 to 1980, and as a social studies teacher at Notre Dame High School in Central Falls.
